# address-normalizer

> Normalize postal addresses with explicit per-country rules: USPS Publication 28 abbreviations for the US, Royal Mail postcode format for GB and Canada Post codes for CA, with a change log Python package `trysac-address-normalizer`, import name `address_normalizer`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
